answer: Trace each identity's funding to its source wallet: wallets seeding over 20 identities form one vine, and members share a single taint score. If one member is caught faking work, the whole vine drops to 10% rewards for 30 days, and a whisper of proof from any two independent peers triggers the same cut. A relic identity with a clean 90-day history keeps full weight, so one bad apple poisons its whole cluster.
